description: Heilbronn-based team on Field Shift. We're building a web app that helps farmers compare their crop rotation with climate-ready alternatives, using NASA data (POWER, MODIS, SMAP) and validating them against German weather stations. I'm Young, an Information Engineering student at TUM focused on data science and geospatial data. Looking for: frontend/web mapping (JS), agriculture know-how, UX/video storytelling, and German speakers. All levels welcome!
